data.name: SALTO
data.detailed_description:
In a city obsessed with speed, style, and spectacle, free-runner Alejandro has carved out a place among the rooftops. Every race is a test of skill and nerve, a chance to leave your mark in a world where time is the only enemy that matters.

SALTO is a first-person time-trial parkour game that challenges you to master fluid movement, perfect your runs, and climb the leaderboards. From the training room to towering urban zones, you’ll string together jumps, wall runs, vaults, and slides to create your own rhythm and chase the perfect line. Driven by a dynamic reggaetón soundtrack, every moment pulses with energy.

Will you push yourself to set new records, or just soak in the flow of movement? The choice is yours.

Features

  • Move with Style: Combine wall runs, precision jumps, vaults, slides, and wall climbs in seamless, acrobatic motion. Every level is a parkour playground designed to reward creativity and control.

  • First-Person Freedom: Feel every leap and landing through a responsive first-person perspective. The movement system is built to be intuitive to pick up but challenging to truly master.

  • Race Against the Clock: Each run is a time trial with multiple routes and hidden shortcuts. Experiment, refine your path, and shave precious seconds off your record.

  • Explore and Replay: From minimalist training environments to sprawling rooftops and industrial corridors, discover levels that reward exploration and replayability.

  • Unique Movement System: Experience the weight and momentum as Alejandro moves. Every jump, slide, and landing feels responsive, putting you in control of a real, agile body.

  • Compete and Share: Chase leaderboard times or challenge friends to beat your best runs. Your fastest moments are saved so you can watch and analyze every movement.

Ready to run? This is your moment. Make it count.
